title: What's on GitHub
lede: Three public repositories with the code, the documentation and the design decisions in plain sight. Take a look before we talk.

resume.title: Professional CV in LaTeX
resume.summary: Generates a CV in four profiles, two languages and two layout variants. That's 16 PDFs in total, all built from a single source of truth, with invariants verified in CI and releases published by tag.

pension-estimator.title: IMSS pension estimator (Law 73)
pension-estimator.summary: A React Native and Expo app that estimates the old-age pension under Mexico's 1973 Social Security Law. An auditable eight-step calculation engine, each step carrying its formula and its legal basis. 116 tests, no backend and no telemetry.

portfolio.title: This portfolio
portfolio.summary: A bilingual site published on GitHub Pages with React, Vite and Tailwind. All the content lives in the i18n resources and is validated against the same source of truth as the CV.
